segments.text: Nisha Patel: We have decided to use spaCy as our NLP backbone for entity extraction. This replaces the earlier proposal to use NLTK.
Priya Sharma: The database schema migration has been completed and deployed to staging. The task is marked as done as of today, August 29th.
Rahul Verma: We need an API rate limiter. We decided to implement Redis-based rate limiting using the token bucket algorithm. Rahul Verma owns this task, due by September 8th.
Nisha Patel: My NLP pipeline integration deadline has been extended from September 5th to September 10th because we added a co-reference resolution module to the scope.
